savesHint: Only the Owner can save or replace the shared world. Unsupported files are rejected; empty slots cannot be loaded.
leaseHint: Take control before driving. Release is available only for your own lease.
toolbarHelp: Toolbars: use arrow keys, Home and End to move; Enter or Space activates. Tab moves to the next group.
dirtyHint: Apply this name before continuing, discard the draft, or keep editing.
draftConflict: This station changed. Reset the draft to review its current name before applying.
draftInterrupted: The session changed. The unfinished station draft was discarded.
sharedReplacement: This replaces the shared world for every participant, clears control and construction drafts, and starts paused. It cannot be undone here.
observerHint: Observers can inspect and change local view settings. Game changes require Owner or Operator access; saves require Owner.
waitForSync: Waiting for a synchronized world and map images.
recoveryHint: The game is unavailable until synchronization completes.
authenticationRequired: Authentication is required again. Enter your access key to join.
closePanelToTarget: Close panel to choose a target
unvalidatedPreview: Preview only. Placement and cost are checked on Confirm.
geometryFailed: Target could not be checked. Select it again to retry.
unavailableObject: This object is no longer available.
leaveFailed: Leaving could not be confirmed. Retry Leave game to sign out.
localAccessHint: Leave the key blank to join locally as Owner.
leaseRequired: Train control expired or changed. Take control again.
loadHint: Select a file to check compatibility. Unsupported data leaves the current game unchanged.
replaceWorld: Replace the current game with this save?
incompatibleSave: This save format is not supported. Prototype saves cannot be loaded. The current game was preserved.
referenceWorldHint: Explore the eight-direction rail loop and run, pause or step the calendar. Economy, trains and construction are not available yet.
operationUnavailable: This operation is not available in the spatial reference world.
savingUnavailable: Saving is unavailable for this reference world.
invalidSave: Invalid save data. The current game was preserved.
saveFailed: Save operation could not be confirmed. Check the connection and server storage.
soundFailed: Sound could not play. Try enabling it again.
mapHelp: Click an object to inspect. Drag to pan; middle drag or Space + drag pans in every tool. Use the wheel or buttons to zoom.
constructionHelp: Select a tile, then confirm. Tools keep shared time running; use Pause when needed. 100 per changed tile; buffer extension costs 200. Removal has no refund.
assetsFailed: Map images could not load. Reload to retry.
pickTile: Select a tile on the map
pickObject: Select a map object to inspect
manualHelp: Manual: focus the map. Shift passes; Up departs; Down reverses; Left / Right choose a junction. Run advances time. Escape cancels.
visualSample: Visual sample by the pier: water, fence and slope. Winter ground and recoloring are local display options.
title: FreeTrain Online
subtitle: Web prototype
networkNotice: Inspect the world, operate the train and extend the siding. Changes are confirmed by the game service.
incompatible: Client and server versions differ. Reload after updating.
operatorSecret: Enter access key to join game
accessFailed: Access failed. Check the key and try again.
unresolved: A command outcome is unresolved. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
staleEpoch: The world was replaced. Reconnect and review the current game.
notAuthorized: Operator access is unavailable. Reconnect to sign in.
queueFull: The server is busy. Review state before trying again.
retryWindowFull: Command history is full. Wait before sending more commands.
requestConflict: This request ID was already used for a different command.
invalidInput: The command was rejected. Your draft is retained.
staleRevision: The item changed. Review the confirmed state and retry.
unavailable: Connection unavailable. Reconnect and review state.
catalogHint: Imported building families · select a height to inspect.
terrainWorldHint: View terrain and check locations. Terrain editing and railway construction are not available yet.
emptyWorldHelp: Create flat ground at the global water level, with no rails or decorations. Defaults store 30 × 42 × 6 cells (the source dialog displays 30 × 30 × 6). Custom H/V: 1–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells; Z: 1–64; water: 0–Z−1. Preview does not pause shared time; any world change invalidates it.
creationFailed: World creation failed or its outcome is unknown. Check the current world before making a new preview.
staleCandidate: This preview is out of date. Preview again.
creationBusy: Another world preview is active. Cancel it or retry after it expires.
heightmapHelp: Import an opaque, single-frame PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF (up to 8 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 4 million pixels). Stored H/V: 1–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells. Brightness sets height; steep steps are lowered and slopes smoothed. Water uses one global level.
heightmapTerrainPreview: Resulting terrain heights and global water
imageFormat: Unsupported image or mismatched file type. Choose PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF.
imageBytes: Choose an image between 1 byte and 8 MiB.
imagePixels: The image exceeds 4096 pixels per side or 4,194,304 total pixels.
imageAlpha: Transparent pixels are unsupported. Choose an opaque image.
imageAnimation: Animated images are unsupported. Choose a single-frame image.
imageInvalid: The image is damaged or cannot be decoded. Choose another image.
generatedHelp: Generate reproducible plains, hills or mountains from a signed integer seed. Relief sets height variation; feature scale sets the wavelength in cells; smoothness reduces fine detail. Stored H/V: 16–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells; Z: 8–64; water: 1–Z−4. Preview never changes the shared world; confirmation uses the exact previewed terrain.
coastHelp: Inland has no coastal sea. An island has sea around its entire boundary. Selected directions use the world compass, keeping other boundary sectors dry. Target sea coverage is measured before lakes and rivers (±5 percentage points). Channels may divide the landmass. Small maps or extreme settings may be impossible.
coastCompass: Overview compass: North ↖ · East ↗ · South ↘ · West ↙ (stored H/V view).
coastMetrics: Surface water: {water}% · Dry cells: {land} · Open water components: {seas}
coastCoverageImpossible: Sea coverage cannot be met on this map. Change coverage or use a larger map, then preview again.
coastTopologyImpossible: A connected landmass and coastal seas cannot be formed with these settings. Change coverage, seed or map size, then preview again.
coastBoundaryImpossible: The requested coast boundary cannot be formed. Increase map size or change coverage or coast directions, then preview again.
waterFeaturesHelp: Lakes and rivers share the global water level. A river crosses the map in the selected compass direction and joins any sea along that axis. Lakes and rivers merge wherever they overlap; isolated lakes keep a dry rim. Lake area is approximate (±1 percentage point or 25% of its target, whichever is larger). Decorative creeks are separate.
waterSettingsInvalid: Check feature ranges and available space.
lakeImpossible: The lake area or separating dry rim cannot be formed. Reduce lake count or area, enlarge the map, or change seed.
riverImpossible: The river or its banks cannot be formed. Reduce width, enlarge the map, or change seed or direction.
forestUnavailable: Select at least one available tree species.
forestHelp: Coverage selects a percentage of dry, reusable cells outside the starting area. Higher clustering makes larger groves. Each cell uses the species’ original scatter density; some selected cells naturally have no trees. Starting area reserves existing level land and does not reshape terrain. Other foliage is unavailable until its installed recipes are reviewed.
forestMetrics: Eligible: {eligible} · Selected: {mask} · Forest cells: {forests} · Trees: {trees} · Reserved: {reserved} · Largest level patch: {flat}
forestLegend: Overview: dark green = realized trees · gold = reserved starting area.
startingAreaImpossible: A connected level starting area of this size cannot be found. Reduce its size or change terrain, seed or map size.
